context.transcript:
Yoshi, at last week's Manufacturing Trade Show, I saw some new technology that could really help improve productivity here at the factory by up to 10%.
Really?
What is it?
A smart helmet.
A helmet with a screen attached that managers can pull down to access information and communicate with the control room.
Managers can wear the technology instead of carrying it around so their hands will be free.
There was a budget surplus at the end of last quarter.
Great.
I could talk to the helmet makers about a possible demonstration for everyone.
That'd be good.
Thanks.
context.transcript_translation:
约西，在上次的制造贸易展上，我看到了一些新技术，可以真正帮助提高我们工厂的生产力高达10%。
真的吗？
是什么？
一个智能头盔。
一个带有屏幕的头盔，经理可以拉下来获取信息并与控制室通信。
经理们可以佩戴这项技术而不是携带它，这样他们的手就会是空闲的。
上个季度末有预算盈余。
太好了。
我可以和头盔制造商谈一下为所有人进行可能的演示。
那会很好。
谢谢。
